name: Prosper
source: Lieutenant Prosper, perhaps the military's most ruthless and cunning Lieutenant, was sent together with his men to a small village to investigate the rape and murder incident and to subsequently hunt down the suspected culprits, the anti-government guerrillas. What the naive villagers don't know yet is that the incident was actually all planned out by him so that he could have a gang rape party for himself. All women who were suspected of being guerrillas were arrested. That was the beginning of the insane gang rape party with Lieutenant Prosper at the helm of it.
